caption_L1: This bar chart is titled Regional distribution of BBC network TV programming spending in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2012 to 2019. The y-axis measures geographic region. A linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5 can be found on the x-axis, labeled 2014.
caption_L2L3: London is shown to have had the most resources for the year 2014. The north of England also seemed to receive a large number of resources whereas the midlands, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales receive only a small proportion of the resources.
